hook_text: 10:20 minus 06:45 is 3 hours 75 minutes? Something is very wrong.
clip_script: School tour from Polokwane to the Kruger National Park. Leave 06:45, arrive 10:20. Do not subtract like normal numbers. Count on: 15 minutes to 07:00, 3 hours to 10:00, 20 minutes to 10:20. 3 hours 35 minutes. Game drive at 15:30 for 2 hours 45: add 2 hours, 17:30, then 45 minutes, 18:15. The park was proclaimed in 1926. To 2026 is 100 years: 10 decades. Time counts in 60s, so count on.
visual_style: A bus moving along a number line of hours, then a sun setting as the game drive clock ticks to 18:15.
mood: Adventurous, like the start of a bushveld safari.
pacing: The 75-minute trap, the count-on jumps, then the game drive and the decades.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out how long your school day lasts.
